claude.rationale: gap_45 is 0 because Microsemi's business as a whole — product/asset portfolio and its operations — crossed intact into the surviving corporation "with no carve-out or partial-asset separation," so the customer-facing product and its producing processes moved together. gap_56 is 1 because at the effective time Microchip-side officers (Sanghi/Moorthy/Bjornholt) replaced Microsemi's pre-merger leadership at the surviving-corporation board and executive level, while Microsemi's own named officers were covered by retention/severance rather than continuing to run the transferred operations — a structural process-vs-people mismatch at closing. This T5/T6 gap was contractually addressed via pre-negotiated retention agreements, double-trigger severance, and cash/equity retention arrangements documented for key employees at closing, so gap_mitigated is yes. No transition-services agreement was identified, and T1 is coded replace given the documented change in control and installation of new controlling leadership.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a whole-company reverse triangular merger where Microsemi's business, products, and operations transferred intact (T4 and T5 moved together, so gap_45 is 0). While the executive leadership was replaced by Microchip's officers, there is no documented structural mismatch or gap between the operational processes and the organization/people running them at closing (gap_56 is 0).
